text:
No, live plants can't be shipped to PO boxes. PO boxes can only be used for non-living items such as pots, soil, tools and accessories.

For a plant order, you'd need to use a street address where someone can receive the parcel, such as a home, a workplace, or a trusted friend or neighbour. Keep in mind that live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so it helps to choose an address where someone will be around to bring the plant in promptly.

If you have a mixed order with plants and non-living items, the whole order ships together on a plant day, so it would also need a street address.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
